headline: Google and Apple Fined $61 Million in South Korea App Store Crackdown
summary: South Korea fined Google and Apple $61 million for forcing developers to use their in-app payment systems and unfairly delaying app reviews.
why: Regulatory penalties on dominant app store operators underscore global antitrust efforts to curb anti-competitive payment mandates and platform gatekeeping.

impacts.name: Google
impacts.why: Regulatory fines and forced payment system changes impact software service margins in South Korea.
